composition_variation: Design an original premium 2D anime wallpaper featuring one beautiful 29-year-old adult woman on a bench in a minimalist sculpture garden. Her clear dark eyes, fine brows, gentle cheekbones, and faint amused smile convey mature, confident elegance. Jet-black straight shoulder-length hair stays behind her cheeks. She wears an opaque sky-blue short-sleeved midi dress with a modest round neckline and relaxed waist, plus tan lace-up sandals. Sitting comfortably, she places one foot on a low footstool directly in front of her and gently adjusts its sandal strap with both hands. Her torso inclines only slightly, her knees remain together, and the flowing skirt securely covers them. Use a compact full-body seated portrait: her complete head, hands, knees, and both sandals remain visible inside the central column, with the raised foot directly below her hands. Place the camera at her seated eye level. A small white abstract sculpture, low clipped hedges, and pale gravel establish the setting. Diffused morning light creates soft blue shadows and luminous skin. Keep her in the middle and lower frame, with the upper 25% calm and empty for the clock. Refined linework, natural anatomy, opaque fabric, no text, logos, bystanders, or copied characters.
